subject: spirit_vessel
description_en: Active: Soul Release  When used against enemies, it reduces health by %enemy_hp_drain%%% of current health per second, and reduces Health Restoration by %restoration_reduction_enemy%%%. Deals %soul_damage_amount% damage per second.   When used on allies, it provides %soul_heal_amount% health regeneration per second.   Lasts %duration% seconds.  Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within %soul_radius% units or the user dies.
notes_en: Empty vessels gain 2 charges.
Only the closest Spirit Vessel to the dying hero will gain a charge.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

subject: swift_blink
description_en: Active: Swift Blink  Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.  After teleportation, you gain %bonus_movement%%% phased movement speed and +%bonus_agi_active% Agility for %duration% seconds.   Swift Blink cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes_en: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

subject: talisman_of_evasion
notes_en: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

subject: tango
description_en: Use: Devour  Consumes a target tree to gain %health_regen% health regeneration for %buff_duration% seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.  Comes with %tooltip_charges% charges.  Can be used on an allied hero to give them one Tango.  Tree Range: %abilitycastrange%
notes_en: Heals for double duration when used on a Ironwood Tree or Wards.

subject: tango_single
description_en: Use: Devour  Consumes a target tree to gain %health_regen% health regeneration for %buff_duration% seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.  Tree Range: %abilitycastrange%
notes_en: Heals for double duration when used on a Ironwood Tree or Wards.

subject: tpscroll
description_en: Use: Teleport After channeling for %tooltip_channel_time% seconds, teleports you to a target friendly building.   Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
notes_en: If multiple heroes teleport to the same location in succession, the channeling time will be increased for each successive hero.
Teleport can be prevented or canceled by Root abilities.

subject: tranquil_boots
description_en: Passive: Break  Whenever you attack a hero or are attacked by any unit, the bonus %bonus_health_regen% HP regen is lost and the movement speed bonus is reduced to %broken_movement_speed% for %break_time% seconds. Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

subject: travel_boots
description_en: Upgrade: Town Portal Scroll Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units, reduces cooldown and does not consume a charge on usage.  Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes_en: Movement speed bonuses from boots do not stack.

subject: travel_boots_2
description_en: Upgrade: Town Portal Scroll Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units and heroes, reduces cooldown, channel time and does not consume a charge on usage.  Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes_en: Movement speed bonuses from boots do not stack.

subject: ultimate_scepter
description_en: Passive: Ability Upgrade Upgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.

subject: ultimate_scepter_2
description_en: Passive: Ability Upgrade Upgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.

subject: ultimate_scepter_roshan
name_zh: 阿哈利姆福佑 - 肉山
description_en: Passive: Ability Upgrade Upgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.

subject: urn_of_shadows
description_en: Active: Soul Release  Provides %soul_heal_amount% health regeneration when cast on allies, and deals %soul_damage_amount% damage per second when cast on enemies.  Lasts %duration% seconds.  Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within %soul_radius% units.
notes_en: Empty urns gain 2 charges.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

subject: vanguard
description_en: Passive: Damage Block  Grants a %block_chance%%% chance to block %block_damage_melee% damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and %block_damage_ranged% damage on ranged.
notes_en: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.

subject: veil_of_discord
description_en: Active: Spell Weakness  Cast a %debuff_radius% radius blast that causes enemy heroes to take %spell_amp%%% increased damage from spells.  Can be cast while channeling.  Duration: %resist_debuff_duration% seconds.
notes_en: Spell Weakness does not stack with Bloodstone's Spell Weakness Aura.

subject: vladmir
description_en: Passive: Vladmir's Aura Grants %lifesteal_aura%%% lifesteal, %damage_aura%%% bonus damage, %mana_regen_aura% mana regeneration, and %armor_aura% armor to nearby allies.  Radius: %aura_radius%
notes_en: Lifesteal on attacks against creeps is reduced to %lifesteal_creeps_tooltip%%%.

subject: voodoo_mask
description_en: Passive: Spell Lifesteal Heals the wearer for a percentage of spell damage dealt to enemies.
notes_en: Does not heal from Pure or Reflected damage.

subject: ward_dispenser
description_en: Use: Plant  Plant the currently active ward.  Double-Click to switch the currently active ward.
notes_en: Hold Control to give one ward to an allied hero.
